en: Colorized panoramic view over a European town with dense tree cover in the foreground and tightly packed buildings with red and gray roofs in the middle. A tall church with a pointed spire and a large castle-like complex stand on a rocky hill to the left, overlooking the town. Factory chimneys and multi‑story townhouses are visible, with open countryside and fields stretching into the distant horizon. The caption "Leisnig i. Sa." appears printed in red at the top left.
